implementation.screw: Native articulation prismatic+revolute with mimic gearing -0.003/360 metres per degree; positive rotation advances positiveZ. Virtual axial carrier with1% mass allocation, no graph.
implementation.foot: Native spherical joint, 12 degrees per swing axis, captive translation and free yaw. PhysX articulation uses a pyramidal swing envelope, approximately17 degrees diagonal; not an exact12-degree circular cone. Contact alignment tested with a5-degree lower workpiece face at480Hz.
implementation.handle: Passive prismatic +/-27.5mm as source; native angular/linear effort friction estimated.
implementation.friction: Spin static0.03Nm,dynamic0.02Nm estimated workshop thread drag; self-holding is to be tested, not certified under arbitrary load.
implementation.limits: 100 mm travel and12-degree per-axis shoe swing are source-informed estimates. Mass/contact/effort are uncalibrated. Use480Hz for contact clamping;240Hz uneven-contact trial failed retention.

runtime: Isaac Sim6.1rc26 PhysX;480Hz for contact clamping, native schemas, no custom graph.

operations.notes: Native screw rotation advances and retracts the captive jaw at 3 mm per revolution; two-start geometry has 1.5 mm crest pitch.
At 480 Hz, the captive shoe aligns with and retains the tested 5 degree uneven workpiece. No measured load rating or full cone envelope certification.
Native sliding handle travels in both directions and remains captive at its configured limits.
Continuous native insertion, tightening, workpiece-support release, grip under weight, reverse release, removal and repeat with the tool visibly supported.

assumptions: Source-informed dimensions and solid-mesh mass estimates.
limitations: No measured force rating or friction calibration.
12degree per-axis spherical envelope is pyramidal, not circular.
Official joint-movement aggregate passed with 2 of 4 sub-probes responding; separate native screw and swivel proofs support those operations.
The tool is supported during workpiece use; robot grasping and calibrated force control are not qualified.
